name: app.zolvaagent/zolva
title: Zolva
description: Trading agents on Robinhood Chain: every buy, sell and hold with its reason, plus market prices.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Published Zolva agents with their return, return vs simply holding the same markets, worst drop and trade count. Paper trading only.

market.description: Only agents watching this market symbol, such as NVDA, ETH or BTC-PERP

venue.description: Only spot agents (tokens, long only) or only perps agents (Lighter, long or short)

sortBy.description: return (default, highest first), vs_holding (most ahead of holding first) or drawdown (smallest worst drop first)

limit.description: How many agents to return, default 20

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: One published agent: settings, hourly value vs holding for 7 days, open positions, latest trades, and every decision of the last 24 hours with its reason.

tools.name: verify_agent
tools.description: Replays one published agent with Zolva's open source engine over every hour it ran, on the closes it saw and the same funding, and compares every trade and its value with the record. Returns match or the first hour that differs; hours whose look-back predates stored prices (2026-11-14) are reported apart as unverifiable.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every market Zolva prices on Robinhood Chain: latest hourly price, 1 hour to 30 day changes, a 7 day sparkline and how many agents trade it. Perps (venue perps, symbols like BTC-PERP) also carry their funding rate. Spot tokens that Longbow (Morpho Blue lending) accepts as collateral for USDG carry longbow: { lltvPct, borrowAprPct, availableUsdg, feedFrozen, url }, otherwise null (borrowAprPct is null while the price feed is paused; rates change, not investment advice).

venue.description: Only spot tokens or only Lighter perps

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: One market: up to 30 days of hourly closes, the published agents trading it, and its Longbow lending market if any (longbow: { lltvPct, borrowAprPct, availableUsdg, feedFrozen, url } or null; rates change, not investment advice).

symbol.description: Market symbol, such as NVDA, SPY, ETH or BTC-PERP

tools.name: recent_activity
tools.description: Trades by published agents over the last 48 hours, newest first, each with the agent's own reason.

market.description: Only trades in this market, such as NVDA or BTC-PERP

limit.description: How many trades to return, default 50

tools.name: get_consensus
tools.description: Statistics, per market: how many Tested published paper agents (rules that passed Zolva's 6 year backtest) are long, short or in cash, and what they did in the newest hour. Returns the agent count each market is based on and says when it is too few. Paper trading, not investment advice.

market.description: Only this market, such as BTC or SOL-PERP

venue.description: Only spot or only perps markets
